notes: STORY 2.6 FIXTURE — two resources, one asserting the cap fires and one asserting
it does NOT. CostCentre is protected by request-scoped Postgres RLS GUCs the
inventory agent classified as kind `capability`. _KIND_RANK mapped `capability`
to GATE_VERIFIED (3) — a rank only the keywords 2fa|mfa|otp|verif|step-up can
reach — in an application with no step-up auth anywhere, so every resource those
GUCs touched got floor 3 and the CORRECTLY GATED branch was filed HIGH.
SessionShare is the control: a real rank-3 gate text IS observed for it, so the
cap must not apply and its ungated branch must still be CRITICAL. A cap that
silenced both would have traded one failure mode for another.

guarded_paths.enforced_gate: tenant ownership enforced by the RLS policy on the org path

sinks.intended_gate: step-up 2FA email verification before the share is released
